A /v1/systemone probability source does not fit TopK; the seam is build_scorer/ScorerHandle + scorer_predictions (run.py ~525, ~650), and to_prediction already carries candidates/raw_scores/offered, so everything downstream (core/predictions.py) is distribution-only.

The release-gate Provider protocol (base.py:194) with ProviderCapabilities(logprobs, batch, reasoning) would take a new SystemOne provider; today openai_compat.py derives a distribution from first-token top_logprobs (request.distribution_from_logprobs, request.py:118). The provider layer already refuses heldout/heldout-mc tagged requests (base.py:64-67, 238).

There is no adapter interface: backbones/__init__.py and causal_lm/__init__.py are skeletons, and stages import causal_lm directly (pipeline.py:1049, 1206-1207, 1507/1519/1582, 1649; measure/run.py:90-91, probe.py:53-54, predictions.py:35, serve.py:72-73; release/bundle.py:35; cli/_commands/ask.py:28). readout.py hard-codes the A-Za-z letter alphabet; train.py is Qwen3.5-causal-specific (check_text_only, lora_targets). Extracting the seam is a prerequisite and overlaps issues #6 and #7.

Latest 2B checkpoint (created 2026-10-05) is a PEFT LoRA adapter on Qwen3.5-2B-Base, not Gemma; strands_decider_config.json says head_type pointer, pointer_dim 256, num_slots 24, max length 4096; served by its own 'strands-decider serve' (127.0.0.1, no auth) exposing /v1/systemone on cuda/mps/cpu. Training recipe is published (train_config.json, training/configs/v21b-s5.yaml, strands-labs/strands-decider, Apache-2.0) and already uses a teacher-distillation weight 1.0 and kl_frozen_weight 0.3. Head code not read.

label_loss (:463) is the only loss: CE over offered letter columns (+ optional label smoothing and Brier term); Example rows (:132) carry a gold index only. grep for kl_div/soft label/distill/kullback over the package returns nothing, so soft targets need a new row schema, a new loss and a new assemble/freeze path. Heavy deps stay in the train extra (transformers 5.5.0, peft 0.21.0, trl 0.24.0; torch from cu130 index per docs/training-env.md), imported lazily in a subprocess.

nvsh never distilled: teachers draft/augment/review hard-label rows only (scorer-finetune-playbook.md:67-72, 290, 469); 'distill' appears only as prose (docs/pi-rpc.md:6); train_scorer.py is log-softmax CE. There is no nvsh code to absorb for KL.

Present: bootstrap_ci (:339) / _stratified_bootstrap_ci (:370), ece_bins/ece/compute_calibration (:418-458), reliability_markdown (:558), brier_one (:449), _timing (:609, cold/warm/p95 latency). Missing entirely (grep): macro-F1, JSD, confident-wrong rate, peak memory (serve.py/run.py record nvidia_smi text and startup_s only). compute() bars are built on propose/escalate/explain via expect_kind (:173).

The release gate replays saved predictions and asks reference models the same cases, then selects among candidates against BAR_DIRECTIONS (prereg.py:31) with lexicographic RULE_ORDER (safety, accuracy_floor, permutation_robustness, calibration, mc_escalation, ties); there is no student-vs-teacher-vs-baseline paired comparison. Issue #8's planned protocol also has no bootstrap CIs, macro-F1, JSD or teacher-vs-student comparison.

quantize runs llama.cpp convert_hf_to_gguf -> llama-imatrix -> llama-quantize Q4_K_M (quantize.py:738, 777) and measures through the letter-logprob served scorer; heal_needed/HEAL_MARGIN_POINTS=3.0 (quantize.py:603-713) matches decide/rules.py:508-522 (HEAL_ROUNDS=1; a second trigger is stop_escalate); heal = 1 epoch at lr 5e-5 from the run's own merged checkpoint, enforced by resolve_hyperparameters (train_scorer.py ~670). The GGUF path only converts llama.cpp-known architectures, so a pointer head will not convert as is.

preregister hashes prereg.json into prereg.lock.json (:251); require_registered (:273) is called by train, select and decide and refuses a changed sha without --deviation-id; train candidates must be pre-registered names (pipeline.py ~1320). The current bars (wrong_mutating, ece, permutation_change, mc_escalation, right_proposals; RIGHT_PROPOSALS_MINIMUM 0.95) are tool-scorer shaped.

check_train_source (assemble.py:316) refuses any non-train side (TRAIN_SIDE='train', :81); core/leakage.py enforces exact and near-duplicate leakage against the protected sides; the held-out drafter must not be a teacher (draft.py:734).

OnceLedger is an append-only once-ledger.jsonl keyed by (side, slice), not by model; check() raises OnceError on a second measurement without --deviation; --model is action=append (run.py:1190) so one --final invocation can score teacher, baseline and student back to back; calibration.refuse_if_test_or_held_out (:146) and sweep_gate.refuse_unless_final (:105) guard the rest.

temperature_scale/fit_temperature (:180, :354) and vector_scale/fit_vector (:191, :365) are label-agnostic (keyed by metrics.expected_label), fitted on the fit fold only; select_calibration (:578) keeps the vector only if selection-fold ECE drops. Issue #17 also says 'Do not assume the upstream calibrated text temperatures transfer to our domains'.

pipeline.run(apply=False) returns plan() and writes nothing (pipeline.py:2400-2430); --apply needs a work root outside any git worktree (workroot.py:19), holds RunLock, and --detach needs --apply; GPU_STAGES=(train, heal, quantize, measure) with assert_gpu_free and run_capped under capped.sh (gpu.py). The jev-CLI domain is generated from the live argparse tree (generate.py _walk :60, _problems :124); tests pin operations == subcommands (test_jev_cli_domain.py:54-100). A new verb needs an Annotation (annotations.py _FACTORY :88-103, read_only=False for --apply verbs, enforced generate.py:94), >=2 PARAPHRASES (content.py:153), >=4 seed entries in >=3 phrasing classes with dry-run and apply phrasings (test_jev_cli_content.py:162,185), stays <=52 candidates, and changes cli_surface_sha256 (generate.py:227) — so the seed review pending for t34 would grow. New 'jev run' stages are generated from pipeline.REGISTRY (run.py:139-165) and get `run.<stage>` annotations (annotations.py:103), so they also touch the domain.

Stage(name, func, inputs, outputs, deps, summary) (stages.py:28) in a topologically sorted Registry (:38) with per-stage manifests (:120, :222) and staleness (:138); build_registry(registry=None) (pipeline.py:2345) accepts a fresh Registry, but REGISTRY, get_stage, effective_knobs, plan and run are bound to the global DEFAULT_REGISTRY/DEFAULT_KNOBS (:2354, :265), so a separate distill pipeline needs a small parameterisation refactor; appending stages needs none.

The Domain contract is tool-action shaped: Operation(name, description, read_only, args) (:141) with read_only required, CONTROLS=(explain, escalate) always offered (:55), letters A-Z a-z capped at 52 (:64), is_mutating treats unknown names as mutating (:21), validate requires >=1 operation and >=1 reason. Typed choice/noul/score questions would have to be faked as operations, and the read-only/mutating gate (core/gate.py decide :235) would be meaningless.

#15 recommends checking a quantized model by cosine against a bf16 reference and then re-measuring downstream calibration, and notes the SystemOne 'confidence' field is not a probability (gate on max(probabilities)) — relevant to how teacher soft labels are read and how teacher quant drift is checked.

lobes owns serving: new 'decider' role (c13 confirmed) on the upstream /v1/systemone wire passed through unchanged (c19 confirmed); Clef 27B on the Orin at W4A16 via Marlin since NVFP4 needs Blackwell and the Orin is Ampere sm_87 (c4); the 2B may sit on any lobe box (c20 confirmed); the Strands decider is retrained on the DGX Sparks and 'The jev-factory work (producing decider training data / retraining) runs in a separate session ... this frame consumes its output only' (c17, c18 confirmed). So the distillery's quantized student is for deployments other than that bf16 lobes lane, and must not assume lobes will serve it.

scope_entries.surface: Jev System One wire (HF Cloudflare/clef card, Contrastive-LM/CLM-v0.1-8B card, strands-decider README, uspraveen/Jevify docs/JEV_CONTRACT.md)
scope_entries.finding: No formal spec or OpenAPI exists; the de-facto standard is TypeSafe's Jev 'System One' POST /v1/systemone, which Clef, Strands Decider and CLM all implement: request {model, state (string|object|array), questions:{id:{type, instructions?, criteria?}}}; choice criteria {option: description} (2-255 options) -> {choice, confidence, probabilities}; score criteria = ordered level list (2-10) -> {score (expected index), legend, probabilities, confidence}; noul -> {noul: P(true)}. Multi-question records are allowed (Clef scores them jointly, Jev isolates them). Strands keeps teacher targets in a separate positional file {i, probs} keyed by row index, which is the fragility the row-keyed design avoids.

typed-decisions (Apache-2.0) stores exactly a /v1/systemone body (state, questions as JSON columns) plus a gold JSON of full per-question distributions (mean of 3 teacher samples at T=0.7, so soft gold), splits train/test, 4 workflows, 400 test cases / 2,000 decisions; CLM's finetune.py consumes this shape. jev-bench (code uspraveen/Jevify; 22 configs, 166,054 rows, mixed per-source licences in manifest.json) is one (state, question, label, soft_label) triple per row with train/validation/test, soft_label = human vote shares in 4 configs. Neither has read_only/mutating or tool structure; a tool domain maps on as one choice question whose criteria are the verbs.
#15: the SystemOne 'confidence' field is 'not a probability', gate on max(probabilities); JEV_CONTRACT.md documents per-vendor confidence formulas and that Jev's score confidence is not reproducible.

Teacher is a frozen Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (teacher_file data/teacher_v20.jsonl, teacher_weight 1.0), applied only 'on the short-task rows where it agrees with the gold label'; kl_frozen_weight 0.3 is 'KL(frozen || student) over the option-number readout' (precompute_frozen_kl true), a pull toward the frozen start model; also ordinal_smoothing 0.1, shuffle_options true, reverse_score_prob 0.5, 1 epoch. The training code was not read, so the frozen-KL reading is unconfirmed.

/v1/rank {context, question, answers} -> {ranked:[{rank, candidate, prob}]} exists only in CLM; Strands accepts up to 4 base64 images only when served with --vision (422 otherwise), Clef takes images/videos, CLM and Jev are text-only.

obligations.seam: jev CLI: distill --help, explain distill, status
obligations.behavior: 'jev distill --help' lists every distill stage; each side-effecting stage prints its plan and writes nothing without --apply; 'jev status <work>' reads every distill stage's manifest
obligations.source_text: 'jev distill' takes a public /v1/systemone-format dataset through teacher audit, teacher labelling, operator-reviewed corrections, a zero-shot benchmark, distill training, selection, quantize/heal-once, recalibration and one final measurement, and produces a private bundle of a distilled Strands Decider 2B with calibration, its gate, the data it trained on (with every target's source), and a report comparing it with Clef and with stock v21.

obligations.behavior: The distill verb (and each distill stage) has an annotation with read_only=False where --apply exists, >= 2 paraphrases and >= 4 seed entries marked pending operator review; the generated operation list still matches argparse exactly
obligations.source_text: The distillery is a top-level 'jev distill' verb, a noun group of distill stages (dry-run by default, --apply to commit). Because jev's own verbs are the jev-tool model's candidates, it joins the jev-CLI domain with an annotation, paraphrases and seed entries for operator review.

obligations.seam: teacher-label stage against a fake /v1/systemone server
obligations.behavior: For every (record id, question id) on the train side it stores a probability vector over exactly the offered options summing to 1 within 0.01, with teacher repo id, revision, build/quant, engine, request config and response sha256; an incomplete or malformed answer is recorded as a teacher error, never as a label
obligations.source_text: A teacher-label stage asks Clef over the SystemOne API (POST /v1/systemone) for every train-split item and stores the full per-option probability vector (soft label), not just the argmax, with provenance: teacher HF repo id, revision, quantization, serving engine, request config and a sha256 of each response.

obligations.behavior: Predictions are built from 'probabilities' (or noul P(true)) only: a fake server returning a deliberately wrong 'confidence' produces a byte-identical predictions record
obligations.source_text: The vendor 'confidence' field is never used as a probability or a gate input: it is defined differently per model (CLM: top minus mean of rest; Jev choice: (pmax-1/K)/(1-1/K)). Only per-option probabilities are read, then calibrated.

obligations.seam: distribution-only stages (calibrate, gate sweep, metrics, select, decide)
obligations.behavior: They run on a synthetic typed-question predictions record with no model present and import neither backbones.causal_lm nor the pointer backbone
obligations.source_text: A pointer-scorer student backbone adapter for Strands Decider 2B (Qwen3.5-2B-Base + LoRA r16/alpha32 + a separate pointer head in head.safetensors, pointer_dim 256, num_slots 24): prompt rendering, readout, trainer, merge+verify, predictions emitter, serve and quantize, behind a real backbone seam.

obligations.behavior: alpha = 0 reproduces gold cross-entropy within 1e-6 on fixture rows; a row with no teacher target contributes zero KL; KL is >= 0 and equals 0 when student and teacher distributions match
obligations.source_text: Distill trainer: loss = alpha * KL(teacher soft labels || student) + (1 - alpha) * CE(gold) where gold exists, with per-question-kind distillation temperature, LoRA first; runs in the train venv as a subprocess under the GPU guard (run_gpu_stage).

obligations.behavior: macro-F1, JSD to gold, JSD to teacher, confident-wrong rate, log-loss and peak memory each match a hand-computed fixture and report a seeded bootstrap CI that is identical across reruns
obligations.source_text: Assessment adds macro-F1, JSD to gold, JSD to teacher, confident-wrong rate, log-loss and peak memory, each with bootstrap CIs, next to the existing ECE/reliability, Brier and latency metrics.

obligations.behavior: Student, teacher and v21 are resampled with the same item indices per bootstrap draw; a student with higher accuracy but higher ECE than v21 is reported as a regression
obligations.source_text: A paired release gate compares the distilled student against the teacher and against the un-distilled student with bootstrap CIs on paired per-item differences, and an accuracy gain with worse calibration counts as a regression.

obligations.seam: final distill report vs hashed distill pre-registration
obligations.behavior: Each success-signal bar (accuracy vs v21 with paired CI, >= 50% gap closure to Clef, ECE <= 0.10 and <= v21, confident-wrong <= v21, latency <= 1/5 Clef) is computed from the single final measurement on human-gold clean sources, cited with n and CI against the prereg; a miss is recorded as a miss
obligations.source_text: On the final test side, measured once, against human-labelled gold from clean (non-overlapping) sources: the distilled student's accuracy beats stock v21 with the paired-bootstrap 95% CI of the difference above 0 and closes >= 50% of the v21-to-Clef accuracy gap; its calibrated ECE is <= 0.10 and no worse than v21's; its confident-wrong rate is no worse than v21's; and its median decision latency is <= 1/5 of Clef's on the same box. typed-decisions agreement is reported, not gated. The thresholds are pre-registered before the first distill training command.

obligations.behavior: Distill train refuses without a schema-valid, hashed distill prereg (bars, rule, knob grid incl. alpha, temperature, teacher filter, teacher-weak floor); a changed prereg is refused without a deviation id
obligations.source_text: Distillation has its own pre-registration (bars, selection rule, the teacher and un-distilled student as reference rows, and the knob grid: alpha, temperature, student size, data mix) locked before the first distill training command; any later change is a recorded deviation.

obligations.seam: teacher-label stage and assemble leakage check
obligations.behavior: A non-train record sent to teacher labelling is refused; teacher-labelled and corrected rows are leakage-checked (exact, near-duplicate) against fit/selection, test and held-out before assemble, failing closed and printing ids only
obligations.source_text: The teacher labels the train split only. Its soft labels never reach the fit/selection folds' training targets, and nothing from the sealed held-out or test side is ever sent to the teacher or used to build soft labels; teacher-labelled train rows pass the existing exact + near-duplicate leakage check, which fails closed.

obligations.seam: once ledger for distill final measurement
obligations.behavior: A second final measurement of test or held-out, for any of teacher, v21 or student, exits non-zero without a deviation id
obligations.source_text: Test and sealed held-out are measured once: the teacher, the un-distilled student and the distilled student are scored in one final invocation (or the teacher's predictions are saved once and replayed), never as separate measurements.

obligations.behavior: It runs on train-side items only, uses only sources with human-labelled gold, and writes a per-source table (n, accuracy, log-loss, ECE, teacher-weak flag vs the prereg floor) before any soft label reaches assemble
obligations.source_text: Teacher trust is measured per domain/source before distilling: a teacher-audit pass scores Clef against human-labelled gold on the train side (accuracy, log-loss, ECE per source); where it falls below a pre-registered floor, that domain is flagged 'teacher-weak' and its rows take corrected or gold-only targets instead of Clef's soft labels. Sources whose gold is itself model-generated are not used to flag Clef.

obligations.behavior: Every row names exactly one target source (operator correction, human gold, alternative teacher, Clef), the precedence rule applied, the correction id or teacher build id, and whether the agree-with-gold filter kept its teacher target
obligations.source_text: Correction records have one precedence order, recorded per (record id, question id): human/operator correction > public human gold (e.g. jev-bench soft_label vote shares, typed-decisions gold) > an alternative teacher's soft labels > Clef's soft labels. Each training target says which source won and why.

obligations.behavior: Agent/model-drafted corrections stay proposed until the operator approves or edits them via --serve/--apply; an unreviewed correction never reaches assemble, and the review file records each decision
obligations.source_text: Agent- or teacher-drafted corrections enter as proposed and need operator review before they can train, through the existing 'jev review' seed-review flow (dry-run, --serve, --apply), and the review file is the record.

obligations.behavior: A correction lacking author/source, date or reason (weak|outdated), or matching a protected-side item exactly or near-duplicate, is refused
obligations.source_text: Corrections are train-side only, carry provenance (author or source, date, reason: weak or outdated), pass the same exact + near-duplicate leakage check against the fit/selection, test and sealed held-out sides, and are never derived from protected-side items.

obligations.behavior: A training set whose soft-label rows carry more than one teacher build id is refused unless a deviation id is supplied
obligations.source_text: One distill run uses one teacher build: soft labels from a different Clef build (e.g. NVFP4 after 4-bit) are a new labelling run or a recorded deviation, never mixed into the same training set.

obligations.seam: length filter before train and benchmark
obligations.behavior: Records over the student's 4096-token window are dropped with a per-source count in the manifest; no record is truncated
obligations.source_text: Records whose rendered state + questions exceed the student's 4096-token window are filtered before training and evaluation with a per-source count, or recorded as student-ineligible, never silently truncated; the pointer head itself has no option-count cap.

obligations.behavior: Each evaluation source is marked clean or overlapping with v21's training data and Clef's eval suites; headline numbers use clean sources only unless the prereg says otherwise
obligations.source_text: A contamination check runs before the benchmark: every evaluation source (jev-bench config, typed-decisions workflow, JevBench) is compared with the public datasets listed in v21's training data and with Clef's published eval suites; overlapping sources are flagged and reported separately, never pooled silently into the headline v21 or Clef comparison.

obligations.seam: quantize, heal and recalibrate stages for the student
obligations.behavior: The deployed format is a recorded decision citing spike measurements of each candidate; heal runs at most once and a second trigger exits with stop/escalate; recalibration fits on the deployed quant's own fit-fold predictions
obligations.source_text: Quantize the distilled student to its deployed format, re-measure it, heal at most once if the quant loses more than 3.0 points against its own bf16 (same trigger as the jev-tool path), re-quantize, and recalibrate on the deployed quant's own fit-fold predictions.

obligations.behavior: strands_decider_config.json carries jev-factory's fitted temperature_by_kind (never the upstream values), and calibration.json, gate.json, the training set with per-row target sources and the comparison report are present; no symlinks
obligations.source_text: Deployed calibration lives in both places: jev-factory writes its fitted per-kind temperatures into the bundle's strands_decider_config.json so 'strands-decider serve' emits calibrated probabilities, and ships calibration.json + gate.json for lobes to apply; a per-label vector is kept only if lobes applies it.

obligations.behavior: The bundle loads unmodified in the pinned strands-decider environment and answers a choice, a noul and a score question over /v1/systemone on 127.0.0.1
obligations.source_text: The distilled student's bundle is loadable unmodified by 'strands-decider serve' (the hobson-hf-export/1 layout: LoRA adapter, head.safetensors, strands_decider_config.json, provenance.json), because lobes serves the 2B through that package and passes /v1/systemone through unchanged.

obligations.behavior: A Qwen3.5-2B-Base revision, v21 commit, adapter_sha256 or head_sha256 that differs from the pinned values makes distill train refuse with a hash-mismatch error
obligations.source_text: Before training, the distillery pins and verifies the student's inputs: Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B-Base at an explicit revision, the v21 repo at a commit sha, and v21's adapter_sha256/head_sha256 from its provenance.json; a mismatch fails closed.

obligations.seam: run provenance for teacher, student runtime and trainer environments
obligations.behavior: Each environment's lockfile hash or image digest is recorded in the run; importing jev_factory with torch, transformers, peft and strands_decider blocked succeeds and pyproject dependencies == []
obligations.source_text: Teacher, student runtime and distill trainer each run in their own pinned environment, reached over HTTP or as a subprocess: Clef's card needs transformers 5.10.2 and torch 2.11, strands-decider 0.1.0 needs transformers>=5.15,<6, and jev-factory's train extra pins transformers 5.5.0, so none can share one venv.

obligations.behavior: Launching with an unpinned model revision or package version, or binding anything but 127.0.0.1, is refused
obligations.source_text: Remote model code is pinned and contained: Clef's joint_schema_model.py and the strands-decider package run only at a pinned HF commit sha / package version with hash, inside their own environment, serving on 127.0.0.1 only (strands-decider serve has no auth); the pins are recorded in provenance.

obligations.behavior: Killed halfway and re-run, it re-sends only unanswered items (cache hits counted in the manifest) and its progress shows in 'jev status <work>'
obligations.source_text: Every 'jev distill' stage writes the same per-stage manifest and detached-job log that 'jev status' / '--watch' read, and teacher labelling resumes from its response cache after an interruption without re-asking answered items.

obligations.seam: upload of model and dataset bundles with a fake hub client
obligations.behavior: Without --apply nothing is sent; with --apply repos are created private, fetched back and every sha256 compared; no visibility-to-public call is ever made
obligations.source_text: Every distill write step (teacher labelling, train, quantize, heal, upload) is dry-run by default with --apply to commit, uploads are private-first with fetch-back hash verification, and the base install keeps dependencies = [] (heavy deps behind the train extra, imported lazily).
